argv: mammoth dashboard published data IuZl5tk5KcEHJWTy4tnhrA --input '{"body":{"params":{"descriptor_ids":["fe38c0b407dc107c"]}}}' --profile release --output json --no-input --project 3
detail: Ran twice (2 attempts, both identical). Each run dispatches a job (311, then 313) and then the CLI's own always_wait polling GETs /jobs/{id} and gets back backend_code 4PERM002 PERMISSION_ERROR, "User lacks permission to perform given action" -- envelope: {"error":{"code":"api_error","details":{"backend_code":"4PERM002","endpoint":"/jobs/313","status_code":400,...},"message":"Mammoth returned an API error."}}. However dashboard.job-by-url IuZl5tk5KcEHJWTy4tnhrA 313 (the published/anonymous-scoped job-status route) shows the SAME job actually completed successfully with a real value (58824). This means the CLI is misreporting a successful published-data job as a failure because it polls the authenticated /jobs/{id} endpoint instead of the URL-scoped job route for a published/public-auth dashboard. This looks like a real CLI-side polling defect, not a backend defect.
